problemSignature.risk: a local geometry fix can reduce one violation while creating equal or worse DRC elsewhere

rootCause: Physical PCB mutation needs a transaction boundary and a score gate; candidate edits cannot be promoted from geometry intent alone.
fixSummary: Require DRC total improvement while preserving shorts, unconnected count, forbidden via count, and ERC before committing any board mutation.

conditions: any automated KiCad board geometry mutation

recipe: Accept only if safety gates pass and score improves
